env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local
mkdir $WORK/bin

cd w
logos build -o $WORK/bin/tuples$GOEXE ./g
exec $WORK/bin/tuples$GOEXE
stdout '^7 true$'

-- w/go.work --
go 1.27

use (
	./l
	./g
)

-- w/l/go.mod --
module example.com/tuplel

go 1.27

-- w/l/pair/pair.lgo --
package pair

var V (id int, err error) = (7, nil)

-- w/g/go.mod --
module example.com/tupleg

go 1.27

-- w/g/main.go --
package main

import (
	"fmt"
	"example.com/tuplel/pair"
)

func main() {
	fmt.Println(pair.V.T_id, pair.V.T_err == nil)
}
